dispositions.old_value: Persistent Camera Mode settings live in gmMainLib_804D3EE0->modes.vs_camera. Entry callbacks copy them into CSS, SSS, and StartMeleeData payloads; exit callbacks copy edited CSS/SSS selections back, while the VS exit callback folds match results into gmVsMelee_VsExitInfo and updates KO counts.
dispositions.reason: Corrects direction: match_end is consumed from the shared exit record, not newly folded into it by this callback; source explicitly exposes persistent settings and KO update inputs.
dispositions.replacement: Persistent settings live in gmMainLib_804D3EE0->modes.vs_camera. CSS and SSS entry callbacks copy this record to scene payloads; accepted exits copy selections back. Match preparation copies rules and players into StartMeleeData and installs camera callbacks. Match exit consumes gmVsMelee_VsExitInfo.match_end through result helpers, passes persistent settings to gm_80168710, updates KO counts, and selects state 1.

dispositions.old_value: Implements Melee's Camera Mode, the Special Melee variant in which the fourth controller operates the camera and can take pictures.
dispositions.reason: Pins controller-index-3 snapshot behavior through the installed camera update callback. Avoids treating function-name overlays as evidence for camera motion or a menu category.
dispositions.replacement: Coordinates GM_CAMERA_MODE scene selection and VS setup, installing Camera Mode pause, frame and match-start hooks and snapshot resources. The installed camera frame-update path delegates to a camera UI state table whose normal state reads controller index 3 for B and Z; Z enters a snapshot capture sequence. This unit wires those mechanics into the match rather than implementing the camera UI itself.

dispositions.old_value: A scene-sequencing translation unit centered on a sentinel-terminated GameModeState table; it also owns an aligned 64-bit small-BSS object used as both the enter and exit payload for the GS_CAMERA_VS state.
dispositions.reason: Keeps source-declared storage and table shape, removes unverified alignment and small-BSS placement.
dispositions.replacement: Scene-sequencing translation unit defining a GameModeState array with four entries and a {-1} terminator. It declares static s64 gm_804D68C8 and uses its address for both enter and exit payloads of state 0. CSS and SSS use their respective shared payload records; the VS state uses separate StartData and VsExitInfo records. Section placement and explicit alignment are not established by these declarations.

dispositions.old_value: Owns the game-mode controller for Camera Mode, coordinating resource preloading, character and stage selection, Camera Mode-specific VS setup, post-match bookkeeping, and return transitions.
dispositions.reason: Four scene registrations, preload setup, scene payload preparation and match-exit bookkeeping support the unit-controller role.

dispositions.old_value: Camera Mode is represented by states 0 through 3 for its Camera VS prelude, character select, stage select, and VS match scenes. Prelude exit values 1 or 2 and CSS pending-scene value 2 leave for the menu; canceling stage selection or completing a match explicitly returns to state 1.
dispositions.reason: Four registered state IDs and all explicit exit/cancel routes are visible; normal implicit progression is left to the scene engine.
